newsitem.title: USA: Ford confirms new Lincoln sedan.
newsitem.headline: Ford confirms new Lincoln sedan.

text.p: Ford Motor Co will introduce a new sporty luxury sedan in the first part of 1999 that will be smaller than its current offerings.

Ford has been known to be developing a smaller rear-wheel drive car for years. The automaker confirmed Sunday it will be called the LS6 and LS8. The names correspond to the six cylinder and eight cylinder engine configurations that will be offered.

Ford made the announcement from its annual Lincoln-Mercury dealer introduction show, being held in San Diego. The new car shares a platform with a smaller sedan that is being developed by the Jaguar luxury car line, which Ford also owns.
Lincoln spokeswoman Anne Doyle would not reveal price details, or what model year the car will have. She said about 60 percent of the buyers are expected to be purchasing their first luxury car.

The new car is expected to attract younger buyers than the mid-60 year-olds Lincoln typically draws. Women are likely to constitute 35 percent to 40 percent, up from the 18 percent to 20 percent who buy Lincolns now.
